$instructions: ESTE ARCHIVO ES EL TEMPLATE COMPLETO para replicar estilos de diseño al nivel NewForm/Adisruptive.
Todas las secciones son obligatorias. Si una categoría no aplica a tu estilo, usa "none" o array vacío [].
Los valores en este archivo representan el estilo NewForm — un sistema editorial/financiero con UN solo color de acento neón.
Para usar con Gemini: 'Replicá este estilo usando el template adjunto. Quiero [N] slides de [1080x1080|1080x1350] para [propósito].'
Cada componente incluye el CSS exacto que lo define. Gemini debe usar estas clases tal cual o adaptarlas manteniendo proporciones.
Las reglas 'do' y 'dont' NO SON OPCIONALES — son constraints que Gemini debe respetar estrictamente.

meta.name: NewForm / Adisruptive
meta.description: Editorial financial publication aesthetic. Near-white faintly green-tinted canvas holds massive serif display type at 60-295px. Single neon green accent as surgical punctuation. B&W photography in rounded tiles overlapping or beside display headlines. No card grids, no multi-column features — type scale alone defines hierarchy.
similarBrands: Brainchild (VC fund) — broadsheet-editorial, massive serif display, single vivid accent
Paradigm (crypto fund) — oversized display serif 200px+, monochrome + neon accent
Atelier TOC — magazine-spread layout where type and photography interlock asymmetrically
Werkstatt — near-white pages with oversized serif type, editorial rhythm

canvas.role: Page background — full-bleed canvas for every section
canvas.description: Faintly green-tinted near-white. NOT pure #ffffff. Keeps the site from reading as stark white. Also used for card surfaces — cards are defined by radius + padding, not a different fill.
canvas.constraints: Every section sits on this canvas. Never use pure #ffffff for large surfaces.

ink.role: Primary text, dominant borders, image frames
ink.description: Warm-tinted near-black that pairs with canvas instead of pure black. Used for all headings, primary text, footer backgrounds.
ink.constraints: Primary text color for h1-h6, strong tags, and dominant borders.

inkPure.role: Hard borders, icon strokes, deepest text layer
inkPure.description: Pure black reserved for maximum contrast moments — icon strokes, hard borders, the deepest text layer where ink doesn't provide enough contrast against canvas.

bark.description: Half-step lighter than ink for layered depth — subtle elevated panels, secondary dark backgrounds.

inkSecondary.role: Muted body text, secondary borders, labels
inkSecondary.description: Desaturated green-gray for body copy and secondary text. Keeps muted copy tonally consistent with the green-tinted canvas. Used for paragraphs, captions, labels, detail values.

border.role: Hairline dividers, card borders, subtle separators
border.description: Barely-there green-gray that registers only at large display sizes. Used for footer-bar top border, card borders, calendar grid lines, timeline vertical line.

accent.role: Primary CTA color — filled buttons, selected nav, tick marks, focused conversion moments
accent.description: Neon green. THE ONLY saturated color in the entire chromatic system. Used surgically — CTAs, the '||' mark icon, short tick accents, agenda times, timeline dots.
accent.constraints: NEVER use for body text, headings, or backgrounds. NEVER use as a second saturated color alongside another accent. Only for CTAs, tick marks, nav selected states, and focused conversion moments.

accentSupport.role: Supporting accent — decorative details, low-frequency emphasis
accentSupport.description: Muted moss green. For decorative elements that need green but shouldn't compete with the primary accent.
accentSupport.constraints: Decorative only. Do NOT promote to primary CTA color. Lower frequency than accent.

pollen.description: Very light green-gray. For subtle decorative accents and low-frequency emphasis.
pollen.constraints: Decorative only. Do NOT promote to primary CTA.

success.description: Same as accent. The accent color IS the success color in this system.

families.name: Editorial New
families.ideal: Editorial New — ultra-tight 0.90 leading means lines of type nearly touch
families.usage: Literary-feeling statements. Tight leading is the signature. Lines visually lock together at 0.90.
families.constraints: Weight 300 only. Never go heavier. The display whispers at billboard scale because it stays thin.

families.name: PP Mondwest
families.role: Alternative display voice at 60-295px for architectural/monumental statements
families.ideal: PP Mondwest — geometric, almost western-style serifs
families.usage: Different emotional register from Editorial New — more architectural, more monumental. Used when the message needs gravitas rather than literary elegance.
families.constraints: Do NOT mix Editorial New and PP Mondwest in the same headline. Choose one per headline.

families.name: TWK Lausanne
families.role: Primary UI and body family. All non-display text: nav, labels, body copy, buttons, captions at larger sizes.
families.ideal: TWK Lausanne — 350 weight is the brand's signature body voice: present but never loud
families.usage: Weight 350 for nav and labels (signature voice). Weight 400 for body copy. Weight 550 for rare emphasized UI moments (CTA buttons, strong tags). Weight 200 reserved for whisper-weight display moments.
families.constraints: NEVER use weights heavier than 550. The brand voice lives in the 200-400 range.

weightRoles.200: Rare whisper-weight display moments — barely-there presence
weightRoles.350: Signature body voice — nav items, menu labels, paragraph text
weightRoles.400: Standard body copy, general UI text
weightRoles.550: Emphasized UI: CTA button text, strong tags, wordmark

families.name: Times / Georgia
families.role: System serif for image captions and micro-copy
families.usage: Appears sparingly in image captions and editorial metadata. Short observational fragments, not full sentences. Times' neutrality avoids competing with the custom display faces.
families.constraints: Captions only. Never for headings or body text.

textTransformRules.sectionLabel: uppercase, letter-spacing +0.08em to +0.1em, weight 600, color inkSecondary
textTransformRules.detailLabel: uppercase, letter-spacing +0.08em, weight 600, color inkSecondary, size 11-15px

colorRules.h1 .italic: italic style, keep same weight and color
colorRules.h1 .accentWord: accent (#2bee4b), italic — used for ONE key word per headline maximum
colorRules.h3: inkSecondary (#516254), ui family, weight 600, uppercase, letter-spacing +0.1em — section labels above display headlines
colorRules.caption: inkSecondary (#516254), caption family, italic, 16-22px
colorRules.detailLabel: inkSecondary (#516254), ui family, weight 600, uppercase, letter-spacing +0.08em

typography.pairingLogic: TWK Lausanne handles everything from 11px captions to 155px sub-display moments. When the headline needs to exceed 155px and carry a serif voice, switch to Editorial New (weight 300, tighter apertures, literary) or PP Mondwest (weight 400, geometric serifs, architectural). The choice is editorial, not systematic: Editorial New for literary statements, PP Mondwest for architectural ones. Do NOT mix both display faces in the same headline.

semantic.sectionGap: 80-120px — vertical rhythm between content blocks. No visible divider — whitespace IS the divider.
semantic.elementGap: 20px — inline rhythm between elements of the same type
semantic.footerPadding: 24-28px top (after border), 40-48px bottom, same horizontal as content

card.appliesTo: Cards, images, editorial frames, portfolio cards

pill.appliesTo: Pill-style elements: audience pills, tags, badges, navbar when pill-shaped

cta.description: CTA button shadow — dual-layer GREEN-tinted shadow. The glow is on-brand. A deliberate choice that keeps the luminous accent on-brand even in elevation.
cta.constraints: ONLY on filled CTA buttons. No other element carries box-shadow. NEVER use neutral-gray shadows on the accent button. The shadow must be tinted with the accent color.

surfaces.name: Canvas
surfaces.purpose: Full-bleed page background. Every section sits on this surface.

surfaces.name: Card
surfaces.purpose: Cards use the same hex as canvas. They are defined by 14px radius and 20-28px padding — NOT by a different fill color. No border on primary cards.

surfaces.name: Dark Panel
surfaces.purpose: Rare dark surface for footer or inverted moments. Text on top uses canvas color (#fafffa).

surfaces.name: Bordered Card
surfaces.purpose: When a card needs visible separation, add border: 1px solid border (#c8d2c8). Used for expect-grid cards, audience pills.

postLayout.footerBar: flex row, space-between, padding 24-28px 72-76px 40-48px, border-top 1px solid border, margin-top auto

masthead.name: Masthead / Nav Header
masthead.description: Top bar with split-color wordmark (left) + menu label and green mark icon (right).

wordmark.rule: Split-color: first part in ink (#121613), second part in accent (#2bee4b). Example: 'New' in ink + 'Form' in accent. For Adisruptive: 'ADIS' in ink + 'ruptive' in accent. For Futuraria: 'Futur' in ink + 'aria' in accent.

menu.structure: Menu label text + green mark icon

greenMark.description: Two vertical accent-color bars (3px wide each, 15px tall). The '||' mark. Only decorative element in the masthead.

heroHeadline.name: Hero Display Headline
heroHeadline.description: Massive serif display headline that breaks across multiple lines. The core identity element.
emphasisPatterns: One accent-color word: 'España' — accent + italic, max ONE word per headline
Line breaks with <br> for multi-line rhythm
heroHeadline.constraints: Line-height 0.90 is MANDATORY — lines must nearly touch. This is the signature. Never use 1.0+ line-height for display headlines.

accentTick.name: Accent Tick Mark
accentTick.description: Short horizontal accent lines that function as visual rests between headline and body.
accentTick.positioning: Between headline and body text, or at page corners for decoration. 40-72px wide × 2-3px tall. Opacity can vary from 0.5 (decorative) to 1.0 (functional divider).
accentTick.constraints: Short. Never wider than 72px. Accent color only.

bodyText.name: Body Text
bodyText.description: Paragraphs and inline text in muted sage.
bodyText.constraints: Body text max-width ~560px to maintain readable line length. Use — for em-dashes, not regular hyphens.

ctaButton.name: Voltage CTA Button
ctaButton.description: Primary action — the ONLY filled button. Green background with dual-layer green shadow.
ctaButton.constraints: ALWAYS includes right arrow. Shadow is green-tinted (tinted with accent color), never neutral gray. Only filled button on the page. Never use accent as button background for secondary actions.

ghostLink.name: Ghost Link / Secondary Action
ghostLink.description: Text-only links for navigation where a full CTA would be too loud.
ghostLink.usage: Menu label, footer links, read-more affordances.

imageTile.name: Image Tile
imageTile.description: B&W editorial photography cropped into rounded rectangles.
imageTile.css: 14px border-radius. No border. No shadow. Overflow hidden.
imageTile.style: Black-and-white or desaturated duotone. Tight editorial crops — architectural details, work environments, human subjects in context. NOT product shots.
imageTile.placement: Asymmetric — overlapping or sitting beside massive display headlines. NOT centered in cards. Some tall portrait crops, some wide landscape. Sizes vary, not uniform.
imageTile.constraints: NO color photography. ALL B&W or desaturated duotone. 14px radius mandatory.

captionPair.name: Caption / Editorial Metadata
captionPair.description: Small italic caption for images or footer context.
captionPair.usage: Short observational fragments — not full sentences. Positioned bottom-left of image tiles or left side of footer bar.
captionPair.constraints: Caption family only (Times/Georgia). Never in UI or display fonts.

sectionLabel.name: Section Label (h3)
sectionLabel.description: Small uppercase label above display headlines to give context.
sectionLabel.usage: Precedes the main display headline. Example: 'Evento' → then big 'Design Engineers.España'

calendarGrid.name: Calendar Grid
calendarGrid.description: 7-column responsive grid for event date visualization.
calendarGrid.dayHeaders: L M X J V S D or M T W T F S S — always 1-2 letter abbreviations, uppercase, inkSecondary, centered.

countdown.name: Countdown Timer
countdown.description: Large numbers for event-urgency countdown display.
countdown.structure: Horizontal flex row of items: each has a giant number (120px display family) + uppercase label below.

agendaList.name: Agenda / Schedule List
agendaList.description: Left-aligned time + title + description for event schedules.
agendaList.structure: Vertical stack of items. Each: accent-colored time label (fixed 88px width) → display family title → body description.

timeline.name: Vertical Timeline
timeline.description: Chronological timeline with accent dots on a vertical line.
timeline.structure: Vertical line (border color, 3px) with 18px accent circles at each event. Each event: uppercase accent date label → display title → body description.

speakerBio.name: Speaker / Person Bio
speakerBio.photo: 120px circle, ink background, canvas-colored initials (42px display font) — a typographic placeholder when no photo exists.

blockquote.name: Blockquote / Testimonial
blockquote.description: Large italic quote with left accent border.
blockquote.structure: 4px accent left border → italic quote (display family, 42px) → attribution (ui family, inkSecondary).

audiencePills.name: Audience / Target Pills
audiencePills.description: Checkmark-led pills showing target audience segments.
audiencePills.structure: Flex-wrap row of pills. Each pill: ✓ checkmark (accent, bold) + text (ink). Bordered canvas bg. Pill radius.

expectGrid.name: Expectations / Features Grid
expectGrid.description: 2-column grid of feature cards with emoji or icon headers.
expectGrid.structure: CSS Grid 2 columns. Each card: bordered canvas bg, 14px radius, 28px padding, display heading + body text.

statGrid.name: Statistics / KPI Grid
statGrid.structure: Flex row of stat items. Each: giant display number (can be ink or accent) + subtitle label.
variants: ink stat: .stat-big — 96px display family, ink color
accent stat: .stat-big.volt — same size but accent color for emphasis

statCard.name: Stat Card (Carousel PPT style)
statCard.description: Card with big number + label, tinted background.

formFields.name: Registration / Form Fields
formFields.description: Form with uppercase labels and bordered inputs.
formFields.structure: Vertical stack of field groups. Each: uppercase label → bordered input. Canvas bg, border color border. 9px radius.

footerBar.name: Footer Bar
footerBar.description: Bottom bar with italic caption (left) + CTA button (right), separated by hairline top border.
footerBar.structure: Flex row. Left: italic caption (caption family, inkSecondary). Right: CTA button. Hairline border-top separates from content above.

detailRow.name: Detail / Metadata Row
detailRow.description: Horizontal row of label+value pairs for event metadata.
detailRow.structure: Flex row of stacked label+value pairs. Labels small, uppercase, muted. Values larger, ink colored.

chartBar.name: Horizontal Bar Chart
chartBar.description: Comparison bar chart with accent-colored fills.
chartBar.structure: Vertical stack of bar rows. Each: left label → track with gradient fill → right percentage.

chartRadar.name: Radar Chart
chartRadar.description: SVG-based radar/spider chart for multi-dimensional comparison.

chartLine.name: Line Chart
chartLine.description: SVG-based line chart for trend visualization.

personalityGrid.name: Personality / Quadrant Grid
personalityGrid.description: 2×2 grid of personality/quadrant cells with icons.

formulaBox.name: Formula / Code Box
formulaBox.description: Left-bordered box for formulas, equations, or key metrics.
formulaBox.structure: Tinted bg, 3px accent left border, right-side radius only. Monospace or ui font for formula, smaller note below.

divider.name: Divider / Separator
divider.description: Hairline horizontal rule between sections or content blocks.
divider.defaultStrategy: Sections are separated by generous whitespace (80-120px), NOT visible dividers. The absence of a divider IS the divider. Use visible dividers only inside components (footer-bar top border, between card rows, between stat groups).

slide.name: Slide Container (Carousel/PPT)
slide.description: Container for 1080×1350 carousel slides — the PPT/deck format.
slide.difference: Same design system as 1080×1080 posts but 270px taller. More vertical space for content-heavy slides (charts, data, detailed agendas). Masthead, content, and footer-bar proportions stay the same.

accentTicks.description: Short accent horizontal lines (40-72px × 2-3px) placed at page corners or between sections.
accentTicks.usage: Visual rests — small accent beats against the monochrome field. Can be full opacity (between headline and body) or 0.5 opacity (decorative corners).

ornaments.description: Large faint circles in pure black at very low opacity for atmospheric depth.
ornaments.placement: Bottom-right corner area: bottom ~100px, right ~56px. Never center. Never competing with content.

greenMark.description: The '||' icon mark in accent color — 2 vertical bars used in masthead.
greenMark.usage: Only in masthead, to the right of the menu label. Not used elsewhere.

strategyText.description: Special paragraph style for strategic/analytical content in carousel slides.

incubatorTag.description: Special tag for incubation/incubator status with gold dot.

imagery.style: Black-and-white editorial photography throughout. Tightly cropped architectural details, financial infrastructure (ticker boards, server racks, vault interiors), and human subjects in work environments.
imagery.treatment: Monochrome or desaturated duotone. NO color photography appears anywhere.
imagery.frames: 14px border radius. No border. No shadow. Overflow hidden.
imagery.placement: Asymmetric — overlapping or sitting beside massive display headlines. NOT centered in cards. Editorial crops, not uniform sizes. Some tall portrait, some wide landscape.
constraints: NO color photography — all B&W or desaturated duotone
14px radius mandatory on all image tiles
No borders, no shadows on images
Images overlap or sit beside type, never centered in cards
Tight editorial crops, not safe product-shot framing
Visual register is broadsheet financial press, not product marketing

do: Use accent (#2bee4b) ONLY for filled CTAs, the green mark, tick marks, and focused conversion moments — never for body text, headings, or backgrounds
Set display headlines at line-height 0.90 with tracking between -0.04em and -0.01em — this tight leading IS the signature
Pair display faces rather than using one for every display moment — Editorial New for literary, PP Mondwest for architectural
Keep image tiles at 14px radius and let them overlap or sit adjacent to display type — they are editorial crops, not product thumbnails
Use 20px gaps for inline element rhythm and reserve 80-120px for section breaks
Split the wordmark with first part in ink (#121613) and second part in accent (#2bee4b) — this split IS the logo
Let the canvas (#fafffa) carry the page; avoid placing any large surface in pure #ffffff
Use the UI font weight 350 for body — this is the brand's signature body voice: present but never loud
Include a right arrow (→) in every CTA button
Use — for em-dashes in body text
Keep body text max-width to ~560px for readable line length
dont: Do NOT add a second saturated color — the entire chromatic system is ONE accent color
Do NOT use box-shadows outside the CTA button, and never use a neutral-gray shadow on the button — shadows must be green-tinted
Do NOT set display headlines at 1.0+ line-height — 0.90 is mandatory
Do NOT use bordered cards, filled panels, or elevated surfaces — type scale alone defines hierarchy
Do NOT place colored photographs — all imagery is B&W or desaturated duotone
Do NOT use UI font weights heavier than 550 — the brand voice lives in the 200-400 range
Do NOT break the canvas with a dark hero section — the page stays canvas (#fafffa) top to bottom
Do NOT mix both display faces (Editorial New + PP Mondwest) in the same headline
Do NOT use accent color as background for any section or card
Do NOT center images in cards — images overlap or sit beside type asymmetrically
Do NOT use accent tick marks wider than 72px
Do NOT add borders to image tiles

cssCustomProperties.description: Complete :root block ready to copy into any CSS file. Uses available fallback fonts.

promptExamples.prompt: Create a 1080×1080px Instagram post for a conference announcement. Use the NewForm style: masthead with 'ADISruptive' split-color wordmark, hero headline in 96px Playfair Display with one accent-color word in italic, voltage tick below headline, body text in sage at 22px with bold key phrases, detail row with date/location/speaker metadata, footer bar with italic caption and green CTA button with arrow.

Build a 7-slide carousel at 1080×1350px for a conference announcement. Slide 1: title + date + speaker. Slide 2: calendar grid highlighting July 7-11 with accent-colored event days. Slide 3: agenda list with accent time labels + display titles. Slide 4: audience pills with checkmark. Slide 5: countdown timer with 120px display numbers. Slide 6: speaker bio with circular photo placeholder. Slide 7: registration form with uppercase labels + bordered inputs. All slides share masthead + footer bar.

Create a 1080×1350px data slide with a horizontal bar chart comparing two metrics. Use accent-color bar fills on light gray tracks. Include percentage labels right-aligned. Add a stat grid above with 2 big numbers. Masthead + footer bar as standard.

Create a 1080×1080px timeline slide showing a 5-step process. Use the vertical timeline component: 3px border-color line with 18px accent dots. Each step: uppercase accent date label → display title → short body description. Masthead + section label ('Cómo Será') + footer bar with CTA.

Create a 1080×1080px testimonial post. Hero area: 4px accent left border → 42px italic display quote → attribution line in ui font. Keep it sparse — no other content beyond masthead + footer bar. The quote IS the content.

adaptationGuide.description: How to adapt this template for a different brand while keeping the same structure.
steps: 1. Change meta.name and meta.description to your brand.
2. Replace all color hex values. Keep the same number of tokens and the same semantic roles (canvas, ink, accent, etc).
3. Replace font families. Keep the 4-tier structure: display-primary, display-secondary, ui, caption.
4. Adjust the type scale sizes to match your brand's proportions. Keep the line-height + letter-spacing per size.
5. Adjust spacing scale if your brand is more compact or more airy.
6. Adjust radius values per element type.
7. Rewrite shadows to use your brand's accent colors tinted.
8. Keep ALL component CSS structures — just change colors and fonts to your tokens.
9. Rewrite do/don't rules for your brand's constraints.
10. Rewrite prompt examples with your brand's name and scenarios.
12. Change imagery rules to match your photography style.
nonNegotiableStructure: The JSON structure (meta → color → typography → spacing → radius → shadows → surfaces → layout → components → decoration → imagery → rules → cssCustomProperties → promptExamples) MUST be preserved.
Every component must include its CSS definition.
Every color must include role, description, and constraints.
Type scale must include line-height and letter-spacing per size.
Do/don't rules must be explicit and enforceable.
